interface.name: wp_fifo_manager_v1
interface.description: When a Wayland compositor considers applying a content update, it must ensure all the update's readiness constraints are met. This protocol adds completion of a display refresh cycle as a readiness constraint.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: fifo manager already exists for surface

interface.name: wp_fifo_v1
interface.description: Adds display refresh constraints to content updates for one surface.

entry.name: surface_destroyed
entry.summary: the associated surface no longer exists

request.name: set_barrier

description.summary: sets the start point for a fifo constraint

request.description: The barrier becomes active with the wl_surface commit containing this request and clears after the following non-tearing latching deadline.

request.name: wait_barrier

description.summary: adds a fifo constraint to a content update

request.description: The wl_surface commit containing this request is not ready while the previously installed fifo barrier is active.
